title: L12 trusted-AdamW MIXED-PRECISION (BF16 compute / FP32 master) — hardware validation
hardware: real A10 GPU + real Intel TDX, data plane A10<->TDX private VPC
design: BF16 fwd/bwd + BF16 runtime LoRA copies regenerated each step from FP32 master; trusted A{q,k,v,gate,up}+B{q,k} master+m+v+step FP32 in TDX; GPU-exact monomial A{o,down}+B{o,down,v,gate,up} FP32 master+m+v on GPU; no BF16 tensor is authoritative AdamW state
reference: L5 plaintext-domain FP32 AdamW fed the REAL enclave gradients (verification oracle, compare_l5_l12.py); NOT an offline substitute for the hardware L12 arm
preregistered_pass_criteria: registry_amendment_l12_mixed_precision.json (recorded before any mixed-precision result): master_rel_max 5e-3, deltaw_cos_min 0.999, per-step version+1, no rollback, finite

PHASE3_one_step_3seed.verdict: all 3 seeds pass by ~6 orders of magnitude (fp32 fold round-off, not optimizer error); 120 A + 48 B trusted factors compared per seed

PHASE4_ten_step_3seed.state_version_increment: exactly +1 per step (1..10), no rollback, missing=0, rt_match=true every step, finite every step

PHASE5_fifty_step_3seed.note: effective-equivalence top1=1.0 at step 50 (LoRA delta now dominates; the 1-step top1 0.952 was a bf16-forward-vs-fp32-HF measurement artifact on a near-zero delta, NOT an optimizer defect; the compare oracle checks both arms at matched fp32 -> 1e-8)

PHASE5_restart_continuity_test_seed1234.session_A: steps 0..25, versions 1..26, encrypted checkpoint written (durable ciphertext only)
PHASE5_restart_continuity_test_seed1234.session_B: FRESH attestation (verified, debug_false), restored v26 after AEAD+run_id+package_root+adapter_id+version validation, continued steps 26..49 -> versions 27..50
PHASE5_restart_continuity_test_seed1234.rollback_probe: restore with bumped expected version -> service rejected (fail closed)
PHASE5_restart_continuity_test_seed1234.verdict: restart path produced a BIT-IDENTICAL final adapter to the uninterrupted 50-step run; rollback protection verified live on hardware

PHASE9_performance_communication_per_ste.measured_on: 50-step runs, median per step, A10+TDX private VPC
PHASE9_performance_communication_per_ste.network_fraction_of_step: ~0.39s of 0.59s (~66%) is A10<->TDX round-trips; remainder GPU fwd/bwd + host
PHASE9_performance_communication_per_ste.one_step_note: higher due to fresh attestation + first-call/handshake overhead
PHASE9_performance_communication_per_ste.trusted_logical_invocations_note: ce_dlogits + adamw_step (init/checkpoint/restore are per-session, not per-step)
PHASE9_performance_communication_per_ste.enclave_state_footprint: trusted master+m+v for 168 factors, FP32; A-factor 8x896, B q 896x8 / k 128x8
PHASE9_performance_communication_per_ste.checkpoint_bytes: AEAD blob of full trusted state; written to TDX durable (ciphertext only); see restart_test
PHASE9_performance_communication_per_ste.gpu_evidence: on-host 100Hz logger during a 50-step run: peak 2753 MiB VRAM held by the runner PID, util bursts to 72%, 1241/2400 samples nonzero-mem
